verdict.rationale: Kling documents a RESTful API with JWT AccessKey/SecretKey auth and global and China endpoints. Per-call API pricing covers core generation modes: text-to-video, image-to-video with start/end frames, motion control, video input and audio. An MCP/CLI entry point is also advertised, so the main generation features are clearly API-accessible. However, nothing shows that UI-only features (Agent brainstorming, Skills, the node-based canvas, multi-round post-production editing, team workspaces) are exposed through the API, so parity is unproven. Missing for 10: documented UI–API feature parity, API coverage of Agent/Skills/node workflows and editing, and independent hands-on confirmation of API completeness.
